name: The Ironforge Brigade Needs Explosives!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The Ironforge Brigade has put in an unusual request for highly... volatile... components.  Gather them and bring them to Mr. Nozzlespring from the Ironforge Brigade.
narrative.objectives: Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, yes!  These will come in handy! Much obliged, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have something for me, adventurer?

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing IV
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing IV
